Button GroupActions

The `m3e-button-group` component — strict per-component surface.

import M3e
import M3e.Values
These helpers are our examples, not the library

The Doc.* helpers in these examples are this docs app's own module — not part of elm-m3e (they won't resolve from a fresh install). You rarely need anything like them. The library gives you typed components (M3e.*) plus TypedHtml for standard HTML, and you never import HtmlIr: M3e.Element, M3e.Attr, M3e.Node, M3e.Values.Value and M3e.Kind.Supported / .Shared are all re-exported, so every type annotation you need is reachable from the brand. Build layout, text, and links directly from those. The genuine escapes ship with the library too, in one greppable, lint-fenced place — M3e.Unsafe (fromHtml, fromNode, recast, and customElement for a custom tag the types can't express) and M3e.Unsafe.Attributes. See Escapes.

Usage

Standard

M3ecomponentbuildHTML
M3e.buttonGroup []
[ M3e.iconButton [ TypedHtml.Aria.label "Back" ] [ M3e.icon [ M3e.Icon.name "arrow_back" ] [] ]
, M3e.iconButton [ TypedHtml.Aria.label "Forward" ] [ M3e.icon [ M3e.Icon.name "arrow_forward" ] [] ]
, M3e.iconButton
[ TypedHtml.Aria.label "Add"
, M3e.IconButton.width M3e.Values.wide
, M3e.IconButton.variant M3e.Values.filled
]
[ M3e.icon [ M3e.Icon.name "add" ] [] ]
, M3e.iconButton [ TypedHtml.Aria.label "Picture in picture" ] [ M3e.icon [ M3e.Icon.name "picture_in_picture" ] [] ]
, M3e.iconButton [ TypedHtml.Aria.label "More options" ] [ M3e.icon [ M3e.Icon.name "more_vert" ] [] ]
]

component is identical to the M3e tab for this example — its content has no required slots or attributes for the component surface to enforce, so it would be a hollow duplicate of M3e. Reach for component on an example whose composition it can hold a guarantee over.

M3e.ButtonGroup.build
|> M3e.ButtonGroup.withChild (M3e.IconButton.view [ TypedHtml.Aria.label "Back" ] [ M3e.Icon.view [ M3e.Icon.name "arrow_back" ] [] ])
|> M3e.ButtonGroup.withChild (M3e.IconButton.view [ TypedHtml.Aria.label "Forward" ] [ M3e.Icon.view [ M3e.Icon.name "arrow_forward" ] [] ])
|> M3e.ButtonGroup.withChild
(M3e.IconButton.view
[ TypedHtml.Aria.label "Add"
, M3e.IconButton.width M3e.Values.wide
, M3e.IconButton.variant M3e.Values.filled
]
[ M3e.Icon.view [ M3e.Icon.name "add" ] [] ]
)
|> M3e.ButtonGroup.withChild (M3e.IconButton.view [ TypedHtml.Aria.label "Picture in picture" ] [ M3e.Icon.view [ M3e.Icon.name "picture_in_picture" ] [] ])
|> M3e.ButtonGroup.withChild (M3e.IconButton.view [ TypedHtml.Aria.label "More options" ] [ M3e.Icon.view [ M3e.Icon.name "more_vert" ] [] ])
|> M3e.ButtonGroup.toElement
<m3e-button-group>
<m3e-icon-button aria-label="Back">
<m3e-icon name="arrow_back"></m3e-icon>
</m3e-icon-button>
<m3e-icon-button aria-label="Forward">
<m3e-icon name="arrow_forward"></m3e-icon>
</m3e-icon-button>
<m3e-icon-button aria-label="Add" width="wide" variant="filled">
<m3e-icon name="add"></m3e-icon>
</m3e-icon-button>
<m3e-icon-button aria-label="Picture in picture">
<m3e-icon name="picture_in_picture"></m3e-icon>
</m3e-icon-button>
<m3e-icon-button aria-label="More options">
<m3e-icon name="more_vert"></m3e-icon>
</m3e-icon-button>
</m3e-button-group>

API
Types
type Is

The kind row m3e-button-group produces (open — composes into any slot naming it).

type Attrs

The closed attribute-capability row.

type Builder

The narrowed pipe-builder this component's M3e.Build.<X> module exposes.

type AttrCaps

The attribute capabilities this component's builder admits.

type SlotCaps

The singular-slot capabilities this component's builder admits.

type Content

The kinds the default slot admits.

type ChildAdmittedBy

The context demand this container injects into each child's admittedBy row.

type Size

The size values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

type Variant

The variant values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

Density0-1-2-3
Advanced

Motion durations and state-layer opacities — raw CSS custom-property overrides for the 16 transition-timing tokens and 3 interaction-state opacity tokens @m3e/web exposes.

CSS Variables

Non-color @m3e/web CSS custom properties (typescale, shape, motion, state), grouped by name hierarchy. Color tokens live in the Color section. Type a value to override it; clear it to revert. Live default values are not shown — Elm cannot read computed CSS variables.
